notes: Development source comparison, not acceptance of the published 0.3.0 wheel.
Independent TPE only; the default multivariate native-history route is not measured.
Timings include ask, all suggestions, recording and tell; table materialization and setup fixture loading are outside the warmed region.
End-to-end GPU timings include allocation, upload, kernels and download; transfer byte counts are recorded, but isolated transfer seconds are not measured.
Thread counts configure MATLAB and OMP_NUM_THREADS; each operation need not use all configured threads.
Small-case changes are mixed and close to baseline; no universal speedup is claimed.
No Python/DB or Rustuna performance baseline is included.
Earlier overlapping mdx and A100 archival runs were excluded. Initial cache measurements are retained privately; these results use the final small-history path.
